paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.87% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+2.10%) and Hang Seng weakest (-0.08%). Brent crude changed -0.56% to 101.68. Gold changed -0.05% to 4,160.1001. Bitcoin changed +0.83% to 85,468.4922. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.277%, a relative move of +0.76%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (+3.98%) and Glencore (+2.95%) moved the most.
